The test image shows a banana bunch with dark/brown discoloration at the tips (blossom ends) of the banana fingers. The leaves in the background show some edge browning. The key feature is the dark tips on the banana fruit - classic "cigar end" appearance.

Affected plant part: pod/fruit (banana bunch)
Key feature: dark brown/black necrosis at blossom ends of banana fingers

This strongly points to Cigar End Rot. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference image for Cigar End Rot shows exactly what's visible in the test image: green banana fingers with dark brown/black dry rot at the blossom (tip) end. The pattern matches very closely - dark necrotic tips on otherwise green immature banana fruit.
